newsitem.title: USA: Personal loan, retail downgraded - Garzarelli.
newsitem.headline: Personal loan, retail downgraded - Garzarelli.

text.p: Investment strategist Elaine Garzarelli said she has downgraded the personal loan industry and the general merchandise sector of the retail industry.
Her report, issued to clients and released to Reuters, examined companies represented in the Standand and Poor's 500.

The report said she cut the personal loans industry to neutral from attractive. The companies in the S&P group are Beneficial Corp, Green Tree Financial Corp, Household International Inc and MBNA Corp, the report said.
"Although earnings for the group look favorable, valuations are high with a negative 1.6 percent underperformance potential," the report said.
